item.text: Could your team please use clear, consistent filenames for all future file submissions? Including the project name and date would make it much easier for us to identify documents quickly and avoid spending time opening files unnecessarily. Please begin using this naming convention with files sent from next week onward. Thank you for helping us streamline the process.
